summary.text: Robert Stevens is a Republican state representative from Tennessee's District 13 who took office on November 8, 2022, and an attorney.
He advanced from the August 6, 2026, Republican primary and faces Democrat Brett Windrow in the November 3 general election.

paragraphs.text: Stevens earned a B.A. in political science from Lipscomb University in 2006 and a J.D. from the University of Memphis in 2009.
His career experience includes owning a business and working as an attorney, and he has served as president of the Rotary Club of Smyrna.
In the 2023-2024 session he served on the Civil Justice, Education Administration, and Local Government committees.
